verdict.rationale: Neon's own tooling covers the whole agent flow without the dashboard. The hosted MCP server includes project creation, SQL execution and schema-migration tools. `neon claim create` (or the REST claim API) provisions a project with no human signed in and writes DATABASE_URL to .env. The Management API automates project creation programmatically. Probes confirm the MCP endpoint and CLI are live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete end-to-end run (create → connection string → schema → query) by an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a database end to end — create it, fetch the connection string, apply schema, and run queries — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard
